dialogues.jp: 「はあぁぁぁ……」
dialogues.en: Repeated many times over.
dialogues.text: Repeated many times over.

dialogues.jp: 卒業式を終え、帰ってきた教室の机に突っ伏す。
dialogues.en: "Too long!"
dialogues.text: "Too long!"

dialogues.jp:
ひとりひとりの名前を呼ばれ、ゆっくりと卒業
証書を受け取っていく。
dialogues.en: I express my disgust accumulated during the ceremony.
dialogues.text: I express my disgust accumulated during the ceremony.

dialogues.jp: そして、その繰り返し。
dialogues.en:
After handing out those diplomas, we had to listen to the
principal's and other officials' speeches.
dialogues.text:
After handing out those diplomas, we had to listen to the
principal's and other officials' speeches.

dialogues.jp: ずっと、その繰り返し。
「長いっちゅーの！」
dialogues.en:
"What's wrong, Asakura? Your eyes look like a dead
viperfish."
dialogues.text:
"What's wrong, Asakura? Your eyes look like a dead
viperfish."

dialogues.jp: 式中、延々とためこんでいた鬱憤を叫びだす。
dialogues.en: "Viper... What the heck is that?"
dialogues.text: "Viper... What the heck is that?"

dialogues.jp: その後は学長、その他もろもろの関係者のお話。
dialogues.en: "It's a kind of cave fish."
dialogues.text: "It's a kind of cave fish."

dialogues.jp: 「あぐぅぅぅ……」
深海魚って目が退化してるんじゃないのか？
dialogues.en: The eyes of cave fish degenerated, right?
dialogues.text: The eyes of cave fish degenerated, right?

dialogues.jp: どんな目だよ。
dialogues.en: What kind of eyes are they?
dialogues.text: What kind of eyes are they?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、後少しだから、大人しく席につきな」
dialogues.en: "We're almost done, so sit down quietly."
dialogues.text: "We're almost done, so sit down quietly."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生が大きな箱を抱えて、入ってくる。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei enters the classroom with a big box.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei enters the classroom with a big box.

dialogues.jp: 最後の配布物や卒業の記念品とかだろう。
dialogues.en:
There are probably graduation gifts and something to give
out in it.
dialogues.text:
There are probably graduation gifts and something to give
out in it.

dialogues.jp:
杉並も含めて、教室の学生たちが自分の席へと
もどっていく。
dialogues.en:
Everyone in the classroom returns to his or her desk, even
Suginami.
dialogues.text:
Everyone in the classroom returns to his or her desk, even
Suginami.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ……ん？」
dialogues.en: "Good God... Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Good God... Hmm?"

dialogues.jp:
開けっぱなしの後ろのドアから、ふたりの男子
学生が中の様子をそれとなく窺っているのが目
に留まった。
dialogues.en:
I spot two boys quietly peeking into the class through the
back door that had been left open.
dialogues.text:
I spot two boys quietly peeking into the class through the
back door that had been left open.

dialogues.jp: （もう終礼が終わったのか？）
dialogues.en: (Are their classes already done?)
dialogues.text: (Are their classes already done?)

dialogues.jp: まさかな。早すぎる。
dialogues.en: No, I don't think so. It's too early.
dialogues.text: No, I don't think so. It's too early.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、まずはみんなの楽しみにしている通
　知表から渡そうか」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, first I'm gonna give you guys your report cards that
you've been looking forward to."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, first I'm gonna give you guys your report cards that
you've been looking forward to."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、出ておいで」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, come here."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, come here."

dialogues.jp:
教卓の前の音夢に早々と手渡し、暦先生がにこ
やかな笑顔で、教壇から俺を手招きする。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei quickly hands a report card to Nemu, who's
sitting in front of the teacher's platform, and she beckons
me to come over there.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei quickly hands a report card to Nemu, who's
sitting in front of the teacher's platform, and she beckons
me to come over there.

dialogues.jp: きっと、いい成績だったに違いない……。

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、これで最後だね。週番、気合を入れ
　て号令」
dialogues.en: "All right, we're done. Final greeting."
dialogues.text: "All right, we're done. Final greeting."

dialogues.jp:
普段より大きめの号令で全員が席を立ち、礼を
する。
dialogues.en:
At the word of command, which is louder than usual, everyone
gets up and bows.
dialogues.text:
At the word of command, which is louder than usual, everyone
gets up and bows.

dialogues.jp: 終わったか……。
dialogues.en: Finally, it's all done...
dialogues.text: Finally, it's all done...

dialogues.jp: 杉並の席に目をやると、ヤツの姿はなかった。
dialogues.en: When I look at Suginami's desk, he's already gone.
dialogues.text: When I look at Suginami's desk, he's already gone.

dialogues.jp: はて？
dialogues.en: Hmm?
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Male Student A
dialogues.jp: 「くそっ、いないぞ」
dialogues.en: "Shit, he isn't here."
dialogues.text: "Shit, he isn't here."

dialogues.jp:
前後の扉から、ふたりずつ、計４人の男子学生
が、終礼終了とともに駆け込んでくる。
dialogues.en:
As soon as we finish, two boys run into the classroom from
each of the front and back doors.
dialogues.text:
As soon as we finish, two boys run into the classroom from
each of the front and back doors.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student B
dialogues.jp: 「くっ、どこかに抜け道が！？」
dialogues.en: "Damn, there must be a way to escape somewhere!?"
dialogues.text: "Damn, there must be a way to escape somewhere!?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student A
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、追うぞ」
dialogues.en: "Let's find him."
dialogues.text: "Let's find him."

dialogues.jp:
４人の学生は来たとき同様、駆け足で教室を出
て行った。
dialogues.en:
The four boys leave the classroom at a run, the same way
they came.
dialogues.text:
The four boys leave the classroom at a run, the same way
they came.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢せんぱーい」
dialogues.en: "Nemu-sempai~"
dialogues.text: "Nemu-sempai~"

dialogues.jp:
再び、前の扉から学生が教室に飛び込んでくる。
今度は知った顔だが。
dialogues.en:
Now, another student throws herself across the classroom
from the front door. It's a familiar face this time, though.
dialogues.text:
Now, another student throws herself across the classroom
from the front door. It's a familiar face this time, though.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「美春、行くわよ」
dialogues.en: "Come with me, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Come with me, Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「え、杉並先輩は――って、あわわ、杉並先輩
　がいないですぅ」
dialogues.en: "What, Suginami-sempai is?? Oh no, he's not here."
dialogues.text: "What, Suginami-sempai is?? Oh no, he's not here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私たちも追うわよ」
dialogues.en: "We're gonna chase after him as well."
dialogues.text: "We're gonna chase after him as well."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ラジャー」
dialogues.en: "Roger!"
dialogues.text: "Roger!"

dialogues.jp: 美春が元気よく、音夢のあとに続く。
dialogues.en:
Following Nemu, Miharu leaves the classroom
enthusiastically.
dialogues.text:
Following Nemu, Miharu leaves the classroom
enthusiastically.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ……」
dialogues.en: "Well well......"
dialogues.text: "Well well......"

dialogues.jp: 気を取り直し荷物をまとめる。この後は卒パだ。
dialogues.en:
Renewing my spirits, I pack up my stuff. The next plan is to
join in the graduation party.
dialogues.text:
Renewing my spirits, I pack up my stuff. The next plan is to
join in the graduation party.

dialogues.jp:
忘れ物がないよう、何もないはずの机の中も最
後に一応確かめる。
dialogues.en:
So as not to forget anything, I search through my desk,
which is supposed to be empty before I leave.
dialogues.text:
So as not to forget anything, I search through my desk,
which is supposed to be empty before I leave.

dialogues.jp: （おやっ？）
dialogues.en: (Mm?)
dialogues.text: (Mm?)

dialogues.jp: 指の先に、何かが触れる。
dialogues.en: I feel something on my fingertips.
dialogues.text: I feel something on my fingertips.

dialogues.jp: なんかあったっけか？
dialogues.en: Was there something in there?
dialogues.text: Was there something in there?

dialogues.jp:
その薄っぺらいものをつかみ、引き出しから腕
を抜く。
dialogues.en:
Grasping the thin object, I pull out my arm from the desk
drawer.
dialogues.text:
Grasping the thin object, I pull out my arm from the desk
drawer.

dialogues.jp: なかなか、可愛らしい便箋。
dialogues.en: It's quite a pretty envelope.
dialogues.text: It's quite a pretty envelope.

dialogues.jp:
表には、いかにも女の子が書いた可愛らしい、
端正な文字で『朝倉へ』と書かれている。
dialogues.en:
It says 'To Asakura-kun' on the front, beautifully written
in a girl's handwriting.
dialogues.text:
It says 'To Asakura-kun' on the front, beautifully written
in a girl's handwriting.

dialogues.jp:
裏をひっくり返すと、封をするためのハート型
のシールが貼ってある。
dialogues.en:
Turning the envelope over, I see only a heart-shaped seal to
seal the envelope.
dialogues.text:
Turning the envelope over, I see only a heart-shaped seal to
seal the envelope.

dialogues.jp: そして差出人の名前……。

dialogues.en: A love letter?
dialogues.text: A love letter?

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、これはラブレターというやつなんだ
ろうな。
dialogues.en: (Ah?)
dialogues.text: (Ah?)

dialogues.jp: 生まれて初めての経験だが、心は平静だった。
dialogues.en: Click.
dialogues.text: Click.

dialogues.jp:
それともショックが大きすぎて、｛まひ／麻痺｝している
のか？
dialogues.en:
I hear the sound of a puzzle piece in my heart fitting into
place.
dialogues.text:
I hear the sound of a puzzle piece in my heart fitting into
place.

dialogues.jp: いずれにせよ、答えはすでに俺の胸にあった。
dialogues.en: By receiving this love letter.
dialogues.text: By receiving this love letter.

dialogues.jp:
差出人を見た瞬間に、胸にあった幾つもの断片
が自然に組み合わさって答えになっていた。
dialogues.en:
By knowing that there is a strange person who can say that
she likes me.
dialogues.text:
By knowing that there is a strange person who can say that
she likes me.

dialogues.jp: 後は出たとこ勝負だ。
dialogues.en: I realize whom I really love.
dialogues.text: I realize whom I really love.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そっとラブレターを鞄の中に落としこん
だ。
dialogues.en:
I feel everything is clear. The love letter gave me the push
to realize the truth.
dialogues.text:
I feel everything is clear. The love letter gave me the push
to realize the truth.

dialogues.jp: ◆ラブレター◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: 長かった卒業式がようやく終わった。
dialogues.en:
Coming back to my desk from the graduation ceremony, I put
my head down on the desk.
dialogues.text:
Coming back to my desk from the graduation ceremony, I put
my head down on the desk.

dialogues.jp:
忘れ物はないかと覗いた机の中に、一通の手紙
が入っていた。
dialogues.en:
Each of our names was called, and each person slowly
received a graduation diploma.
dialogues.text:
Each of our names was called, and each person slowly
received a graduation diploma.

dialogues.jp: その差出人は……。
dialogues.en: This was repeated.
dialogues.text: This was repeated.
